leads.summary: Open PR #10248 moves the diff to show_diff() but restores the pager-prone invocation, and its interactive test assumes that invocation
leads.location: bin/omarchy-plugin-update:53-62, PR #10248 bin/omarchy-plugin-update patch lines 6-23 and 29-45; PR #10248 test/shell.d/plugin-update-test.sh patch lines 17-27 and 105-113
leads.consequence: These patches edit the same original diff hunk and require reconciliation. Taking #10248's new show_diff() as written drops --no-pager when the user selects Show diff, bringing back the hidden confirmation. Preserving --no-pager in show_diff() instead requires updating #10248's test: its git stub dispatches on $3 (the new diff subcommand is $4), and its assertion expects the exact old argument sequence. This is a conditional merge-order conflict, not a regression in #13345 alone.

leads.summary: Open PR #10711 also replaces the exact diff command when switching FETCH_HEAD to a validated candidate SHA
leads.consequence: Both patches replace the same original line, so the eventual integrator must preserve --no-pager when resolving #10711's HEAD/FETCH_HEAD to HEAD/$candidate change. Taking #10711's plain git diff line loses this fix; replacing it with git -C "$dir" --no-pager diff HEAD "$candidate" retains both. #10711's added test only runs --yes and so will not catch a lost interactive pager fix.
leads.triage: already in Opus final note 4; published in overlapping-PRs note.

## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Verified:** no problems found. `--no-pager` makes git set `GIT_PAGER=cat` (`git.c`), which `git_pager()` checks before `core.pager` and `PAGER` (`pager.c`). `setup_diff_pager()` goes through the same function even when `pager.diff` is set. The diff still prints in colour on a terminal, and the `gum confirm` prompt follows at once.

The script was run in a 24x80 pseudo-terminal with git 2.55.0, less 704 and gum 2.0.0, against a synthetic plugin whose upstream was one commit ahead:

```text
case (no delta)                              base                             head
200-line diff, LESS unset                    less stays open, prompt hidden   no pager, prompt visible
short diff, LESS=R                           less stays open, prompt hidden   no pager, prompt visible
200 lines, GIT_PAGER=less                    prompt hidden until q            no pager, prompt visible
200 lines, core.pager/pager.diff=less -+F    prompt hidden until q            no pager, prompt visible
200 lines, under script -qefc                prompt hidden until q            no pager, prompt visible
```

In the head runs, `y` fast-forwarded the plugin. With a `cat` stub standing in for `delta`, git's output is piped and git starts no pager in either version. With stdout piped and no `--yes`, both versions print the diff and then refuse the same way. With `--yes` the diff is skipped entirely, so the change does not apply.

### Smaller notes

- **Premise precision:** when `LESS` is unset, git sets `LESS=FRX` for the pager, and Omarchy sets no `LESS`. less then quits by itself when the diff fits on one screen, so on a default setup the prompt was hidden only for a diff taller than the terminal (or at any length with a `LESS` lacking `F`, or a custom pager). The code comment could say "a long diff".
- **`omarchy update` path:** `omarchy-update` re-runs itself under `script`, so a `post-update.d` hook gets a pseudo-terminal and the unpatched command pages there. No hook shipped at this head calls `omarchy-plugin-update`, so this path needs a user's own hook. Open #7136 would call it from `omarchy update` itself (with `--yes` only under `-y`), and #6777 would add an Update menu entry that runs it in a terminal. A hook that calls the command without `--yes` still waits for input, now at a visible prompt, even under `omarchy update -y`.
- **Overlapping open PRs:** #10711, #10248 and #11242 rewrite or move the same `else` branch with a plain `git diff`, and #11242 adds a second one for pinning. Whichever lands later needs to keep `--no-pager`.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** source review of `bin/omarchy-plugin-update`, its callers and hook runner, and git 2.55.0 pager source. Isolated pseudo-terminal runs of the base and head script with real git, less and gum, a `delta` stub and stubbed plugin validation and shell rescan. Not run: a real terminal emulator, real `delta`, shellcheck, `test/cli`, or a live `omarchy update`. The inhibitor claim was checked in source only, not the effect of closing the terminal.

**AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, Opus 5.5 Xhigh technical review and final fact check, GPT 6 Sol Xhigh search for related issues, Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.
